points.claim: The Royal Commission into the Robodebt Scheme, led by Commissioner Catherine Holmes, found responsibility lay with the ministers who approved and defended the scheme and with senior public servants.
Scott Morrison took the proposal to Cabinet as Social Services Minister in 2015, and Alan Tudge oversaw the 2016 rollout as Human Services Minister.
Jordan Sample told the Senate the commission found the scheme was "a crude and cruel mechanism, neither fair nor legal".
